---
title: "Tools"
---

[Reports from supplied posterior summaries](your-data.qmd) uses your own summaries or pair probabilities. The
result identifies the set of reports searched, whether the tool enumerated a family, considered cuts of one
order, or used the optional joint solver. The [case-report tool](report-designer.qmd) uses released cases and
records the target, settings, error denominators, and search in the report. Both tools let you download the inputs
and results.
